logline: Gerald and Clarissa arrive at the cottage with an armed constable accusing Alexander of grand theft, culminating in a devastating planted discovery that threatens to tear the newlyweds apart.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately after the intimate moment between Juliana and Alexander in Episode 10, interrupted by the ominous arrival of an aristocratic carriage carrying Gerald.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle tracking shot of heavy carriage wheels churning violently through the muddy, waterlogged track.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Squelch of mud and the grinding rattle of carriage wheels under heavy rain.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot of Juliana and Alexander standing outside the rustic stone cottage, watching the incoming carriage with tense apprehension.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana wrings a damp rag in her hands, her face etched with rising dread, while Alexander stands guard beside her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight shot tilting up as polished black boots step down directly into the muck, revealing Gerald clad in an opulent burgundy double-breasted coat.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Gerald buttons his coat, smug self-satisfaction radiating from his expression.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of a uniformed Constable descending from the carriage, firmly gripping a wooden truncheon.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium tracking shot as Juliana steps defensively toward Gerald, her face full of shock and anger.

segments.label: JULIANA (Startled, Indignant)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Gerald? What are you doing here?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide two-shot across the puddle-strewn ground between Gerald and Juliana against the misty landscape.

segments.label: GERALD (Arrogant, Smooth)
segments.speaker: GERALD
segments.text: I came for something that belongs to me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Clarissa peering from the carriage window in her violet silk gown, a venomous, triumphant smile curling her lips.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana, her anger flaring as she gestures sharply.

segments.label: JULIANA (Furious, Defiant)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You have already taken enough from me. Leave!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Gerald pointing an accusatory finger, his composure snapping into hostile anger.

segments.label: GERALD (Aggressive, Snarl)
segments.speaker: GERALD
segments.text: Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana recoiling in utter disbelief.

segments.label: JULIANA (Incredulous, Gasping)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: What? When?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Gerald narrowing his eyes vindictively.

segments.label: GERALD (Cold, Certain)
segments.speaker: GERALD
segments.text: The last time I came here.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana scoffing, stepping forward as Alexander stands motionless behind her.

segments.label: JULIANA (Contemptuous, Outraged)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You never even entered the cottage!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Gerald smirking with condescending amusement.

segments.label: GERALD (Smug, Threatening)
segments.speaker: GERALD
segments.text: Then you should have nothing to fear from a search.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Three-shot of Alexander, Juliana, and Gerald in the bleak drizzle.

segments.label: JULIANA (Adamant, Protective)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Alexander would never steal from you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot of Gerald throwing his head back in arrogant, mocking laughter.

segments.label: GERALD (Mocking, Spiteful)
segments.speaker: GERALD
segments.text: Of course you would defend him. You married a beggar!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Alexander stepping past Juliana, his gaze murderous and jaw rigid.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Menacing)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Choose your next words carefully.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Gerald pointing back toward the approaching Constable, feigning alarm.

segments.label: GERALD (Shouting, Dramatic)
segments.speaker: GERALD
segments.text: You hear that? He threatens me again!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Constable marching into frame between them, holding his truncheon horizontally.

segments.label: CONSTABLE (Authoritative, Stern)
segments.speaker: CONSTABLE
segments.text: I have received a complaint of theft.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana, defiant and resolute.

segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: A complaint is not proof.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Constable gesturing with his truncheon toward the cottage door.

segments.label: CONSTABLE (Cold, Procedural)
segments.speaker: CONSTABLE
segments.text: Then a search will settle the matter.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana backing up to the doorway, spreading her arms wide to block the entrance.

segments.label: JULIANA (Desperate, Shouting)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You cannot simply invade our home because this man makes an accusation!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Gerald crossing his arms smugly.

segments.label: GERALD (Taunting)
segments.speaker: GERALD
segments.text: If he has nothing to hide...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up push-in on Alexander's scarred face, his eyes smoldering with lethal restraint.

segments.label: GERALD (O.S.) (Smug)
segments.speaker: GERALD
segments.text: ...let the constable search.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Dark, Grated)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Search it.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot of Juliana looking up at Alexander in panicked confusion.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Resigned, Calm)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Let them.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot looking out the doorway as Juliana steps aside and the Constable barges past into the dimly lit cottage.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Heavy thud of boots entering wooden floorboards, followed by forceful banging of furniture.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Constable begins violently overturning crates and dumping contents across the floor.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium low-angle shot of Juliana dropping to her knees, frantically trying to salvage bundles of dried herbs scattering across the boards.

segments.label: JULIANA (Distressed, Pleading)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Constable aggressively pulls folded bed linens from a shelf and hurls them onto the damp floor.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle close-up of Juliana crawling on the floor, looking up with tears streaming down her cheeks.

segments.label: JULIANA (Crying, Desperate)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Please! There is nothing here!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Constable's hands flipping open a small wooden keepsake box on a work table.

segments.label: CONSTABLE (Cold, Indifferent)
segments.speaker: CONSTABLE
segments.text: Then you have nothing to fear.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle close-up of Juliana clutching the fallen linens to her chest, her voice breaking.

segments.label: JULIANA (Heartbroken, Sobbing)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Those are all I have left!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Gerald leaning casually against the cottage doorframe, looking around with contemptuous disgust.

segments.label: GERALD (Cruel, Condescending)
segments.speaker: GERALD
segments.text: Stand aside. Look at this place. A perfect hiding hole for a thief.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana rising to her feet, clutching the folded cloth, her face contorting with rage.

segments.label: JULIANA (Furious, Accusatory)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You planted this accusation because you cannot bear that I am happy without you!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Gerald's face chilling into a cold sneer.

segments.label: GERALD (Scoffing, Sinister)
segments.speaker: GERALD
segments.text: Happy?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Alexander standing in the cottage shadows, eyes locked onto Gerald.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand slowly tightening into a white-knuckled fist.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle close-up of Gerald tilting his chin up, daringly baiting Alexander.

segments.label: GERALD (Provoking, Smirking)
segments.speaker: GERALD
segments.text: What is it, soldier? Going to strike a gentleman in front of his wife?

segments.label: JULIANA (Whispering, Terrified)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Don't!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana clutching her dress collar in acute panic.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (V.O.) (Haunted, Resolute)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: One blow would end this.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Constable stepping up behind Alexander, holding his truncheon firmly across Alexander's chest to restrain him, cutting to a tight close-up of Alexander's smoldering eyes.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (V.O.) (Pained, Selfless)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: But one blow would destroy her life.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Constable turning to Alexander's heavy trench coat hanging on an iron wall hook by the fireplace.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Constable grabs the coat by the collar and begins rummaging through its deep pockets.

segments.label: JULIANA (Startled, Shouting)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: That is his coat!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Constable's hand sliding deep inside the inner coat lining and withdrawing a gleaming gold pocket watch with an attached chain.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Metallic clinking of the gold chain sliding against fabric.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana gasping in sheer horror, her eyes welling with shock and shattered disbelief.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana draws a sharp, terrified breath as her face pales completely.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Alexander's face hardening into lethal, icy comprehension, realizing the depth of the frame-up.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up push-in on Gerald's face erupting into an ecstatic, wicked grin, bursting into triumphant laughter.

segments.label: GERALD (Gloating, Victorious)
segments.speaker: GERALD
segments.text: There it is. Ha!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight macro shot of the gold pocket watch dangling and swaying gently from the Constable's fingers on its long chain, with Gerald blurred in the background grinning with sinister triumph as the scene hangs in a devastating freeze-frame.
